templates.name: Original Data Guest Post
templates.summary: Pitch an editorial contribution built around proprietary research and a concrete audience takeaway.

content.opener: Your piece at {articleUrl} stood out—{specificCompliment}.
content.value: I can contribute an original-data article on {topic}, centered on {offerAngle}.
content.proof: The draft would include a transparent methodology, source notes, and a chart your readers can reuse.
content.detail: I would match {siteName}'s editorial voice, avoid promotional claims, and link supporting context at {yourUrl} only where it helps the reader.
content.close: I can send a three-point outline before writing anything.

templates.name: Practical Playbook Contribution
templates.summary: Offer a step-by-step practitioner guide that fills a clearly identified gap in existing coverage.

content.opener: I enjoyed your guide at {articleUrl}, especially {specificCompliment}.
content.value: A useful next step could be a hands-on {topic} playbook showing {offerAngle} from setup through measurement.
content.proof: I would make every section actionable with examples, decision criteria, and a final checklist rather than generic advice.
content.detail: The proposed structure is: prerequisites, the repeatable workflow, common failure modes, and a compact implementation checklist.
content.close: If that gap is on your roadmap, I can share a tailored outline.

templates.name: Evidence-led Counterpoint
templates.summary: Propose a respectful counterargument that broadens the publication's coverage without chasing controversy.

content.opener: I have been thinking about your argument at {articleUrl}; {specificCompliment}.
content.value: I would like to propose a companion piece that tests the other side of {topic}: {offerAngle}.
content.proof: The angle would be evidence-led and charitable to the original argument, with explicit limits and practical implications.
content.detail: Rather than manufacture a debate, the article would identify when each approach works and give readers a decision framework.
content.close: Would a short thesis and source list be useful for your review?

followUps.subjectTemplate: Last note on the {topic} companion piece

templates.name: Broken Resource Replacement
templates.summary: Report a dead reference helpfully and suggest a relevant maintained resource without applying pressure.

content.opener: While reading {articleUrl}, I noticed that {brokenUrl} no longer resolves.
content.value: The reference appears in the section on {topic}. A maintained alternative is {yourUrl}.
content.proof: It covers the same reader question, includes current examples, and clearly shows its last revision date.
content.detail: Of course, any replacement you trust is better than a dead end; I am sharing ours because it is a close topical match.
content.close: Either way, I thought you would want the broken link on your radar.

templates.name: Outdated Statistic Replacement
templates.summary: Flag an unavailable statistics source and offer a current, well-documented replacement citation.

content.opener: Your article at {articleUrl} explains {topic} clearly—{specificCompliment}.
content.value: One cited statistic points to {brokenUrl}, which currently returns an error. {yourUrl} contains a newer figure for the same claim.
content.proof: The replacement page documents the sample, collection date, and calculation so readers can verify it.
content.detail: If the newer measure is not methodologically comparable, I would keep the wording broad or remove the number rather than imply a false trend.
content.close: I hope the source note saves your team a little research time.

templates.name: Tool Directory Repair
templates.summary: Help a curator repair a dead tool listing while explaining exact replacement fit and maintenance status.
templates.subjectTemplate: Dead listing in the {siteName} tools directory

content.opener: I found a dead listing while using the tools directory at {articleUrl}: {brokenUrl}.
content.value: If you are replacing it, {yourUrl} serves the same {topic} use case and is actively maintained.
content.proof: The page includes pricing, limitations, documentation, and a public support route so visitors can evaluate it before clicking through.
content.detail: I can provide a neutral one-sentence description in your existing format, with no superlatives or affiliate language.
content.close: Thanks for curating the directory; the broken listing was the only issue I encountered.

followUps.subjectTemplate: Details for the replacement tool listing
Last heads-up about the dead tool listing

templates.name: Unlinked Brand Mention
templates.summary: Ask for attribution on an existing brand mention while respecting the editor's linking policy.

content.opener: Thank you for mentioning our work in {articleUrl}; {specificCompliment}.
content.value: Would you consider linking the existing mention to {yourUrl} so readers can find the referenced source directly?
content.proof: That URL is the canonical page and provides the underlying context rather than a sales landing page.
content.detail: I understand if {siteName}'s policy is to leave brand mentions unlinked, and there is no need to change the surrounding copy.
content.close: Thanks again for including us.

templates.name: Original Image Attribution
templates.summary: Request source attribution for a reused original visual in a polite, non-accusatory way.

content.opener: I was glad to see our {topic} visual included in {articleUrl}.
content.value: Could the image credit link to its original source at {yourUrl}?
content.proof: The source page contains the data notes, accessible description, and the most recent version of the asset.
content.detail: A simple linked credit beside the image or in the references section works; there is no need to alter your layout.
content.close: Thank you for finding the visual useful enough to share.

templates.name: Expert Quote Attribution
templates.summary: Connect a published expert quote to its primary profile or research source for reader verification.

content.opener: I appreciated how you used our quote in {articleUrl}—{specificCompliment}.
content.value: For readers who want the full context, would you link the attribution to {yourUrl}?
content.proof: The page includes the complete statement, author credentials, and supporting references.
content.detail: The published wording does not need to change; I am only suggesting a source link on the existing attribution.
content.close: Thank you for representing the point accurately.

templates.name: Current Research Upgrade
templates.summary: Offer a more current research asset by stating concrete coverage improvements instead of vague superiority.

content.opener: I found your {topic} resource at {articleUrl}; {specificCompliment}.
content.value: We recently published {yourUrl}, which updates the subject with {offerAngle}.
content.proof: It adds current data, primary-source citations, and a revision log, while preserving the practical context readers need.
content.detail: It may be a useful supplemental reference where your article discusses recent changes; I am not suggesting it replace stronger existing sources.
content.close: Would you like the two most relevant sections so you can assess it quickly?

followUps.subjectTemplate: Last note on the updated {topic} source

templates.name: Interactive Tool Upgrade
templates.summary: Suggest an interactive companion tool that lets readers apply concepts from an existing educational article.

content.opener: Your explanation at {articleUrl} is unusually clear, particularly {specificCompliment}.
content.value: We built an interactive {topic} tool at {yourUrl} that lets readers apply the process with their own inputs.
content.proof: It runs without registration, explains each result, and includes a printable output for readers who prefer to work offline.
content.detail: The tool complements educational coverage rather than repeating it, so it could sit naturally in the implementation section.
content.close: I can provide a direct demo path if you would like to test it first.

templates.name: Accessible Visual Explainer
templates.summary: Offer a reusable diagram with accessibility metadata and transparent sourcing as an editorial enhancement.

content.opener: I used your article at {articleUrl} while researching {topic}.
content.value: We created a visual explainer at {yourUrl} that maps {offerAngle} in a single view.
content.proof: The asset includes source notes, high-resolution and SVG files, plus ready-to-use alt text.
content.detail: You are welcome to embed it with attribution, crop it to your layout, or use it only as a reference for your own design.
content.close: Would the preview and usage notes be helpful?

followUps.subjectTemplate: Preview + alt text for the {topic} visual
Last note on the reusable visual

templates.name: Tactical Case Study Guest
templates.summary: Pitch a teachable case study with a clear listener outcome, evidence, and candid lessons learned.
templates.subjectTemplate: Podcast idea: the real numbers behind {topic}

content.opener: I listened to your episode at {articleUrl}; {specificCompliment}.
content.value: A useful follow-on could be a tactical {topic} case study about {offerAngle}, including what failed before the result improved.
content.proof: I can share the timeline, baseline, decision points, and outcome without turning the conversation into a product pitch.
content.detail: Possible listener takeaways are the diagnostic framework, the two experiments that mattered, and the warning signs we would watch next time.
content.close: If it fits {siteName}, I can send a one-page episode brief.

templates.name: Contrarian Framework Discussion
templates.summary: Offer a nuanced, defensible framework that challenges common advice and creates a useful host-led discussion.
templates.subjectTemplate: A respectful challenge to common {topic} advice

content.opener: Your conversation at {articleUrl} made me reconsider {topic}; {specificCompliment}.
content.value: I could bring a respectful counter-framework: {offerAngle}.
content.proof: The argument has explicit boundary conditions, examples on both sides, and a practical test listeners can use before choosing an approach.
content.detail: I would welcome pushback from the host—the value is in examining where the conventional rule breaks, not declaring it wrong everywhere.
content.close: Would a five-bullet discussion map help you decide?

templates.name: Audience Question Clinic
templates.summary: Propose an audience-led clinic episode with scoped expertise and useful answers to real submitted questions.

content.opener: I have an audience-led format idea for {siteName} around {topic}.
content.value: Listeners could submit short scenarios, and I would diagnose them live using {offerAngle} as the decision framework.
content.proof: My relevant background and published work are summarized at {yourUrl}, including the limits of what I can responsibly advise on.
content.detail: We could pre-screen questions, anonymize sensitive details, and end each answer with one next step and one common mistake.
content.close: Would that format be useful for an upcoming Q&A slot?

templates.name: Co-marketing Research Project
templates.summary: Propose a balanced joint research project with clear contributions, ownership, and distribution expectations.

content.opener: I have followed {siteName}'s work on {topic}; {specificCompliment}.
content.value: There may be a strong co-marketing project in combining your audience insight with our {offerAngle} capability.
content.proof: We can own research design and analysis, document the method, and share editable assets and raw aggregate results.
content.detail: Before committing, I suggest we agree on scope, review rights, attribution, lead handling, and a simple exit point if the data is not useful.
content.close: Would a one-page concept note be worth reviewing?

followUps.subjectTemplate: One-page scope for the joint {topic} study

templates.name: Joint Workshop Proposal
templates.summary: Suggest a workshop with complementary teaching roles, a practical artifact, and low-friction planning.

content.opener: Your team explains {topic} with unusual clarity—{specificCompliment}.
content.value: I would like to explore a joint workshop where you cover strategy and we teach {offerAngle} through a live exercise.
content.proof: Attendees would leave with a completed worksheet, recording, and implementation checklist rather than a sales presentation.
content.detail: We can handle the run-of-show and production; both teams would approve promotion, speaker data use, and the follow-up sequence in advance.
content.close: Should I send a sample agenda and division of responsibilities?

followUps.subjectTemplate: Last note on the joint workshop

templates.name: Integration Launch Partnership
templates.summary: Frame a product integration collaboration around shared user value, technical readiness, and explicit ownership.

content.opener: I see a practical overlap between {siteName} and our work on {topic}.
content.value: A lightweight integration could let shared users {offerAngle} without rebuilding their workflow.
content.proof: Our relevant API documentation and current constraints are at {yourUrl}; the first version can stay narrow and reversible.
content.detail: We would propose the technical scope, support ownership, security review, success metric, and deprecation path before discussing launch promotion.
content.close: Is there an integrations owner who would be open to a short technical brief?

templates.name: Independent Hands-on Review
templates.summary: Invite an independent product review with full disclosure, editorial control, and no required positive coverage.

content.opener: I value how {siteName} reviews {topic}, especially {specificCompliment}.
content.value: Would you be interested in independently testing {yourUrl}, with access to {offerAngle}?
content.proof: You would keep full editorial control, publish only if it serves your audience, and disclose any complimentary access or compensation.
content.detail: We can provide a test account and technical answers, but we will not request pre-publication approval beyond correcting factual errors you choose to share.
content.close: If relevant, I can send the test scope and disclosure terms in writing.

followUps.subjectTemplate: Test scope for the independent review

templates.name: Educational Live Session
templates.summary: Propose a live teaching session shaped around audience value, moderation, and transparent sponsorship.

content.opener: Your audience discussions around {topic} are consistently practical—{specificCompliment}.
content.value: I would love to co-host a live teardown where we apply {offerAngle} to volunteer examples from the audience.
content.proof: The session would be educational first, with pre-agreed disclosure, moderation rules, and no collection of attendee data without consent.
content.detail: We can provide the worksheet and production support while you lead the questions and keep the session aligned with your community.
content.close: Would a short run-of-show help you evaluate the format?

followUps.subjectTemplate: Last note on the live-session idea

templates.name: Community Challenge Collaboration
templates.summary: Design a participatory community challenge with clear rules, fair selection, privacy, and a useful outcome.

content.opener: I have a community-first collaboration idea for {siteName} around {topic}.
content.value: We could run a short challenge where participants use {offerAngle} to create a useful artifact, not simply post promotional content.
content.proof: We would publish clear eligibility, judging criteria, privacy terms, prize value, and sponsor disclosure before entries open.
content.detail: Our team can supply the workbook and prizes at {yourUrl}; your team would retain final say over community fit and winner selection.
content.close: Would you like a one-page concept with safeguards and workload estimates?

templates.name: Rapid Expert Commentary
templates.summary: Offer timely expert context to a journalist with clear credentials, availability, and zero publication pressure.

content.opener: I saw {siteName}'s recent coverage of {topic}; {specificCompliment}.
content.value: If you are following the story, I can provide on-record context about {offerAngle} today.
content.proof: My relevant credentials and prior work are at {yourUrl}; I can distinguish observed facts, professional interpretation, and uncertainty.
content.detail: I am available by email or a brief call and can respond to a specific question without expecting a quote or link.
content.close: Is there a deadline or angle I should work within?

templates.name: Original Data Brief
templates.summary: Share embargo-ready original findings with methodology, limitations, and a concise relevance statement.

content.opener: Your reporting on {topic} has been valuable, particularly {specificCompliment}.
content.value: We have new data showing {offerAngle}, with the full research brief at {yourUrl}.
content.proof: The brief includes sample details, field dates, question wording, limitations, and downloadable tables.
content.detail: I can share the material under a clearly stated embargo, arrange access to the researcher, or simply answer methodology questions by email.
content.close: Would the top three findings and methodology summary be useful?

templates.name: Constructive Context Note
templates.summary: Provide a respectful factual clarification with primary evidence and no demand for favorable treatment.

content.opener: Thank you for covering {topic} in {articleUrl}; {specificCompliment}.
content.value: I wanted to offer one piece of context: {offerAngle}.
content.proof: The primary supporting material is at {yourUrl}, including dates and the underlying record.
content.detail: I am not asking you to change the article unless this affects its accuracy. If another source contradicts our record, I would appreciate seeing it.
content.close: I am available to clarify the evidence or provide an on-record statement.
